_note: PLACEHOLDER written by Claude. Owner D: replace it and delete this line. stock = what the shop sells after each floor (the key is the floor you just cleared). A floor with no entry has no shop.
_wandering_note: The wandering merchant (met in a room, see data/rooms.json for how often) sells a RANDOM mix every run. always = items he always has. items = how many more he picks from all items in items.json. rarity_weights = for each floor you are ON, how likely each rarity is (a bigger number = more often; a rarity left out is never picked). The pick uses the run's seed, so leaving and coming back shows the same items.
